summary: BitFuFu Inc. filed a Form 6-K on 2026-10-15 announcing the launch of Hashrate Token (HASH), a tokenized note linked to BTC-denominated mining output, developed with tokenization agent Finloop Finance Technology Holding Limited. No deal price, stake, premium, or board recommendation is stated; the product is offered only to eligible investors subject to KYC/AML and jurisdictional limits. Finloop supplies issuance infrastructure via its FinRWA Platform. This is an ordinary product launch, not a special situation; watch for regulatory classification of the token and any capital-markets or disclosure consequences.
